summary:
S-2 (Markdown export) meets C-6. exportMarkdown(store) maps each note to '## title

body
' and joins them, giving one '## title' section per note with the body directly below it. npm test passes 5/5, including the export test that checks section count and order. No block or major findings.

findings.issue: The export test covers only a two-note store. It does not cover an empty store (exportMarkdown returns an empty string) or a note whose body is empty. Neither is required by C-6, so this is a coverage gap, not a defect.
findings.suggestion: Optionally add a case for an empty store asserting the output has zero '## ' headings.

evidence.quote: test("exportMarkdown writes one section per note with the body below", () => {
